Per Intelligence Index Task

The GPT-6 Astra release offers 6 models, each with different intelligence, performance, and pricing characteristics. Below is a comparison of the key metrics across the 6 models.

  • For intelligence, the top model of GPT-6 Astra is GPT-6 Astra (max) at 53.
  • For output speed, the fastest model is GPT-6 Astra (max) at 54 t/s.
  • For latency, GPT-6 Astra (low) at 2.69s offers the lowest time to first answer token.
  • For pricing, GPT-6 Astra (low) at $0.82 offers the lowest cost per task. Prices vary up to 4x across models.
